_OBJECTIVE: Stress test with maximum degradation: heavy rain + mountain terrain (occlusion, clutter, horizon masking) + mixed RCS targets (airliner 30 dBsm vs stealth -10 dBsm). TOMHT should handle compound ambiguity best.
_PASS_CRITERIA: TOMHT completes without crash or OOM. Airliner tracked (Quality > 50%). Mountain terrain produces visible occlusion and clutter.
_NOTE: Uses rain/heavy_rain (40 mm/hr ramp) — previous version used 50 mm/hr but v3.4.1 cleanup standardized on config-file weather references. Directional pass criteria (tracker survives compound stress) remain unchanged.
description: TC-07: Compound stress — TOMHT + heavy rain (40 mm/hr, ramp) + mountain + mixed RCS (747 vs stealth bomber)
